pushSheet.title: Get notified when friends write
pushSheet.body: Manteion tells you about new messages, and about whatever else you turn on in Settings → Notifications. You decide what you get.

blocked: Notifications are off for Manteion in Android’s settings. Turn them on under Settings → Apps → Manteion → Notifications.
testMissing: No test arrived. Check that notifications for Manteion are allowed in Android’s settings.

download.title: Manteion for Android
download.lede: The app shows Manteion’s own notifications, with your friends’ pictures, and lets you answer a message straight from the notification.
download.point1: Notifications from Manteion, not from your browser
download.point2: Reply to a message, or mark it read, from the notification
download.point3: Set the sound and importance of each kind of notification in Android’s settings
download.step1: Tap Download. Your browser may warn that the file could harm your phone: the app comes from Manteion itself, not from Google Play, so download it anyway.
download.step2: Open the downloaded file. Android asks whether your browser may install apps: allow it.
download.step3: Tap Install, open Manteion, and sign in.
download.updates: The app tells you when there is a new version.
download.iphone: On iPhone and iPad, add Manteion to your Home Screen from Safari instead.

update.title: A new version of the app is ready

get.title: Get the Android app
get.body: Notifications from Manteion itself, and replies straight from the notification.
